literal: spy not knowing let one manage together three persons words agreeing to trust will be appropriate
translation: A ruler should manage his spies so that they do not know each other. Information should be trusted only when the reports of three independent spies agree.
modern: ஒரு ஒற்றரை மற்றொரு ஒற்றர் அறியாதவாறு ஆள வேண்டும். அவ்வாறு செயல்படும் மூன்று ஒற்றர்களின் செய்திகளும் ஒன்றாக அமைந்தால் மட்டுமே அதனை உண்மையாகக் கருதி நம்ப வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the method of verifying intelligence gathered by spies. A ruler must employ spies in such a way that they remain completely unaware of one another. Only when the independent reports of three different spies perfectly agree should the information be trusted and acted upon. This ensures that the intelligence is accurate and free from collusion.
